goal: Finish every remaining item of PLAN_five_tickets_v4 and ticket 4, mechanically, so the whole result can be handed to Fable 5 for review and debugging at the end
route_source: Fable 5 sequencing consult 2026-08-16: A-B-C-D-E, verdict written provisionally BEFORE the long measurement so a mid-run cut never loses both, and two verify commands named as liars.
note_on_scope: The parallel Fable session was stopped by the review pass, so its six items move here. Anything built here is meant to be REVIEWED by Fable at the end — reviewing existing code passes where designing it stops.

steps.desc: Commit the verified work uncommitted since fd21ede, and tag it. ONLY files this session touched. ~210 files were already dirty before this work began and belong to someone else — they must still be dirty afterwards.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && n=$(git show --stat --name-only --format= HEAD | grep -c .) && test "$n" -lt 30 && test "$n" -gt 0 && git describe --exact-match --tags HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && test $(git status --short | grep -c '^ M\|^??') -gt 150
steps.verify_note: Three things, because a green commit is the classic false pass: the new commit holds a SMALL named set not hundreds; the tag points at THIS commit; and the pre-existing dirt is still there. A clean working tree here would mean the disaster happened.

steps.desc: From BoringSSL's source, list the extensions it emits by default, and compare against what the target profile requires. This is the single open question the library decision turns on.
steps.verify_note: Counts actual extension rows, not the file's existence. An empty template would otherwise pass.

steps.desc: Write the verdict into docs/TICKET4_DECISION.md, marked PROVISIONAL and explicitly pending step D. If the inventory is inconclusive, say so and keep PROPOSED — an unlocked decision is a fact, not a failure.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && grep -q 'PROVISIONAL — pending the measurement in step D' docs/TICKET4_DECISION.md && grep -q 'TICKET4_EXTENSION_INVENTORY' docs/TICKET4_DECISION.md
steps.verify_note: A generic phrase like 'decided' would match text already in the file. This requires the provisional marker AND a reference to the inventory that justifies it.

steps.desc: The falsification test: a standalone program that opens a connection with the chosen library under configuration alone, captures the exact bytes of the first record it writes, and prints them. Scratch target, not wired into the app.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && test -x tools/first_record_dump && tools/first_record_dump --self-test | grep -q 'bytes captured'

steps.desc: Put the gate id at the front of every test name that proves a gate. Change ONLY test names — no assertions, no logic. Then report which gate ids still have no test at all; those are real gaps and must not be papered over by renaming an unrelated test.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && test $(grep -rhoE "test\('[0-9][a-z]" --include='*_test.dart' packages apps | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -ge 30
steps.verify_note: 21 distinct gate ids are labelled today. The floor of 30 proves work happened rather than the command merely running.

steps.desc: Gate 1f, the one gate in the plan never built: mid-call re-evaluation with hysteresis. Rate may move freely; packetization time needs a larger hysteresis band because changing it mid-call means renegotiating the session description.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3/packages/media_webrtc && dart analyze 2>&1 | grep -q 'No issues found' && dart test 2>&1 | grep -q 'All tests passed' && grep -rq "test('1f" test/

steps.desc: The four pin-policy pieces the parallel session could not do: docs/TICKET4_PIN_RECORD.md, the weekly monitor workflow, the six verify gates as required checks, and the 180-day pin-age ceiling as a FAILING check.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && test -f docs/TICKET4_PIN_RECORD.md && ls .github/workflows/ | grep -q 'pin' && grep -q '180' docs/TICKET4_PIN_RECORD.md

cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && t=0; for p in packages/signed_config packages/media_webrtc packages/call_core packages/adaptive_transport; do (cd $p && dart analyze 2>&1 | grep -q 'No issues found') || exit 1; n=$(cd $p && dart test 2>&1 | grep -oE '\+[0-9]+' | tail -1 | tr -d '+'); t=$((t+n)); done; test "$t" -ge 975
steps.verify_note: Sums the actual test count across packages and requires it to meet the floor already measured (205+116+169+485=975). A grep that matched nothing would otherwise report success with zero tests run.

steps.desc: Update docs/HANDOFF_plan_v4_session.md with what closed, what stayed open with its dated blocker, and the exact next action. Then the whole result is ready to hand to Fable 5 for review and debugging.
steps.verify_cmd: cd /Users/behnam/Downloads/voice_call_kit_v3 && grep -q 'TICKET4_EXTENSION_INVENTORY' docs/HANDOFF_plan_v4_session.md && git describe --tags --abbrev=0 | grep -q .
steps.verify_note: Requires the handoff to name the artefact this run produced, not merely to have been touched.

rules: A step passes only when its verify_cmd exits 0. Status is never written from prose.
Read command OUTPUT, not exit codes alone: flutter install printed 'Install failed' and exited 0 earlier in this project.
Commit after B, C, D and E with an explicit path list, never `git add -A`, so an abrupt end loses nothing.
A measurement that cannot be taken is recorded as not-measured with its reason, never estimated into a cell that reads measured.
The ~210 pre-existing dirty files are never staged. A clean tree at the end means they were swallowed.
Write the ledger row in the same turn as the verifier output, or the row is not written.
If an external adjudication is stopped on a dense subject, do not soften the wording. Measure it, or record the scope UNCHECKED with the count of stops.
